title: Injuries
subtitle: Track what hurts, watch it improve, and keep your training plans away from it.

disclaimer.title: This is a logbook, not a doctor
disclaimer.body: Nothing here is medical advice. The app records how you feel and keeps training suggestions off the affected area — it cannot tell you what is wrong or how to fix it. If pain persists, worsens, or came on suddenly, see a doctor or physiotherapist.

empty.title: Nothing hurting right now
empty.body: Good. If that changes, record it here — the AI coach will route your training around it.

chart.needMore: Check in for a couple of days and the trend will show up here.

delete.title: Delete this injury?
delete.message: This removes the {{part}} record and every pain check-in on it. That history cannot be recovered.
